policy.name: Odisha MSME Development Policy, 2022
policy.order_no: No. MSME-MS&I-MSME2-0015-2022-9678/MSME dated 28.12.2022 (1st amendment No.8795/MSME dated 08.12.2023)

zones.IBD: Industrially Backward Districts: Kalahandi, Nuapada, Bolangir, Subarnapur, Koraput, Malkangiri, Rayagada, Nabarangpur, Kandhamal, Gajapati, Mayurbhanj

zone_lookup: Annexure-I definition 15 (Industrially Backward Districts). IBD only matters for the additional 5% CIS in para 7.3.1(c).

schemes.name: Odisha MSME Policy 2022 Capital Investment Subsidy (general)
schemes.notes: Only enterprises with P&M investment up to Rs 10 crore (new, or existing undertaking expansion/modernisation/diversification). 25% of P&M (invested till commencement of production), max Rs 2 crore. SC/ST/PwD/women/technical-degree-or-diploma entrepreneurs (>=51% stake): 30%, max Rs 2.5 crore (7.3.1(b)). Anchor enterprises 30% max Rs 4 crore (7.3.1(e)). New E-vehicle component/charging units with P&M up to Rs 50 crore: 30% max Rs 3 crore (7.3.2). Production must start within 3 years of first fixed capital investment (9.3). No similar incentive under any other State/GoI policy (9.2). CAUTION: 1st Amendment Notification No.8795/MSME dated 08.12.2023 amends paras 6(g), 7.1, 7.2 and 7.3.1(c) - its text could not be downloaded (ct.odisha.gov.in / msme.odisha.gov.in unreachable); figures here are from the original 28.12.2022 notification.

schemes.name: Odisha MSME Policy 2022 Additional CIS (backward districts / IDCO estates / focus sectors)
schemes.notes: Additional 5% of P&M, max Rs 20 lakh, over and above 7.3.1(a)/(b), for units (P&M <= Rs 10 crore) that are: (i) in Industrially Backward Districts, or (ii) in designated IDCO estates/areas along Biju Expressway, or (iii) in auto & components, plastics & polymers, steel & stainless steel, defence, aluminium, pharma, medical equipment, apparel & textile. CAUTION: 1st Amendment Notification No.8795/MSME dated 08.12.2023 amends paras 6(g), 7.1, 7.2 and 7.3.1(c) - its text could not be downloaded (ct.odisha.gov.in / msme.odisha.gov.in unreachable); figures here are from the original 28.12.2022 notification.
conditions: Unit in a backward area notified in the policy

schemes.name: Odisha MSME Policy 2022 Additional CIS for non-polluting measures
schemes.notes: Additional 5% of investment in technical civil works and P&M for non-polluting measures (WWTP, ETP, waste recycling, rooftop RE, CEMS, rainwater harvesting, green buildings etc.), max Rs 25 lakh, P&M <= Rs 10 crore.

schemes.name: Odisha MSME Policy 2022 Interest Subsidy
schemes.notes: RATE IS A SHARE OF INTEREST, NOT PERCENTAGE POINTS: reimbursement of 50% of interest paid on term loan from public FIs/banks, 5 years from commencement of production, TOTAL cap Rs 1 crore. New enterprises with P&M up to Rs 50 crore only.

schemes.name: Odisha MSME Policy 2022 Electricity duty exemption
schemes.notes: New enterprises with P&M up to Rs 50 crore: exemption from electricity duty up to contract demand of 750 kVA for 5 years from commencement of production.

schemes.name: Odisha MSME Policy 2022 Net SGST reimbursement
schemes.notes: 75% of net SGST paid in cash (after ITC), 3 years from commencement of production, limited to 100% of cost of P&M (ceiling base is P&M, not fixed capital). New and E/M/D enterprises with P&M up to Rs 50 crore. Pioneer enterprises (first five units in a new product line, Annex I def. 4): 100% of net SGST for 5 years, limited to 200% of P&M (7.6.2).

schemes.name: Odisha MSME Policy 2022 Quality certification subsidy
schemes.notes: 100% of quality certification charges (national/international bodies) incl. renewal for next 2 years (3 years total), total max Rs 5 lakh. ZED (7.7): 80% of balance cost after GoI support for ZED certification; plus one-time 50% of P&M/testing equipment cost to move up a ZED level, caps Rs 2 lakh (Bronze) / 3 lakh (Silver) / 5 lakh (Gold).

other_benefits: Stamp duty: 100% (P&M <= Rs 10 cr) / 75% (Rs 10-50 cr) on land/shed transfer from Govt/IDCO/private estates (para 7.1; amended by 8795/MSME - not seen).
Land conversion premium exemption: 100% up to 5 acres (P&M <= Rs 10 cr) / 75% up to 25 acres (para 7.2).
Employment cost: 75% (men) / 100% (women) of employer ESI+EPF, 5 yrs (P&M <= 10 cr) or 3 yrs (10-50 cr) (para 7.9).

Technology purchase from NRDC etc.: 50% up to Rs 20 lakh (7.10); SME exchange listing 20% up to Rs 10 lakh (7.11); water audit 75% up to Rs 1 lakh (7.12); energy audit 75% up to Rs 5 lakh (7.13); patents (7.14).
